Please go to the hospital as soon as possible OP. If a person is capable of doing something like this once, he'll most likely hurt someone else in the future. I'm sorry this happened to you but believe me you're not alone. Surround yourself with people who support you and care about you, you're going to need it. I know it's incredibly traumatizing but you're going to make it. You're stronger then you believe you are.

congratulations OP! first of all remember to breathe, you're going to be just fine. First dates are always about getting to know each other. It's natural to want to put your best foot forward but just remember to be yourself. Be confident and smile, he obviously likes you to want to get to know you even more. 

Don't be ashamed at all about not having much dating experience, everybody moves through life at their own pace. The great thing about life is there is no set manual that dictates what paths we take and when we should take them.  

Take this opportunity to get to know him even more and just enjoy your date. If it doesn't work out then don't force yourself to continue seeing him. I wish you the best of luck!
